exposure: fetal heart state at the time of diagnosis of UCP
outcome: incidence of fetal demise following umbilical cord prolapsed (UCP)
factors associated with fetal demise in pregnancies complicated by UCP
cohort: 438 pregnant women who delivered between January 1st, 2000 and December 31st, 2009 and had pregnancies complicated by umbilical cord prolapse with live fetus at Mulago Hospital, Uganda.
finding: The study found that cesarean section, a diagnosis to delivery interval <30 minutes, and putting the mother in the knee-chest position were associated with reduced perinatal mortality in cases of umbilical cord prolapse.
mod_finding: The study found that cesarean section reduced perinatal mortality by a factor of 2 in cases of umbilical cord prolapse.
